_README: CANONICAL BASIS CONSTANTS. SOLE source basis runs (R1, V_quad-S, M10 threads) may read from. Every value here was RECOMPUTED FROM ITS DEFINITION (mpmath first principles or the defining PCF/formula/recurrence) by pslq/constants/recompute_basis.py - never transcribed from a deposit abstract, prior run, or memory. RULE: any constant whose status is not VERIFIED is BARRED from basis use (the could-not-confirm discipline applied to numbers). STALE-MATCH / DISCREPANCY / UNRESOLVED entries are stop-and-surface and must be resolved by the operator before use.

status_legend.VERIFIED: from-definition recompute matches the latest deposited value; usable
status_legend.STALE-MATCH: recompute matches a superseded/retracted value, not the claimed latest - BARRED, surface
status_legend.DISCREPANCY: recompute matches neither deposited version - BARRED, surface
status_legend.UNRESOLVED: value could not be recomputed from a findable definition - BARRED, surface
status_legend.VERIFIED_VALUE_PROVENANCE_FLAGGED: from-definition recompute is computationally trustworthy (usable), but its PUBLISHED provenance has an unresolved gap (deposit-hygiene to-do) - see status_notes; usable for computation, surface the provenance flag

constants._comment: Canonical entry for the V_quad Stokes constant S. Provenance framing is deliberately honest: the VALUE is computationally confirmed by two independent from-definition recomputes, but its PUBLISHED provenance has an unresolved gap (see status_notes). Do not strip the caveats.
constants.name: S
constants.convention: universal 2*pi resurgence normalization (prefactor 2*pi = 6.28319), NOT the retracted Gamma(beta_exp) = -6.00599 convention
constants.definition_source: Dingle late-term formula S = prefactor * K, where K = lim |a_n * xi0^(n+beta) / ((-1)^n * Gamma(n+beta))|, with beta = -1/(3*sqrt(3)), xi0 = 2/sqrt(3), sigma = -1/sqrt(3); WKB/Riccati machinery for the V_quad PCF 1 + K_{n>=1} 1/(3n^2+n+1). Recomputed independently by pslq/constants/recompute_basis.py and pslq/constants/S_prefactor_verify.py
constants.defining_object: V_quad quadratic PCF, Stokes constant via Dingle late-term amplitude

supersedes.prefactor_ratio: 2*pi / |Gamma(beta_exp)| = 1.04615282843 = exactly 0.457906/0.437705; the entire v1.0->v1.1 discrepancy is mechanically this single prefactor swap, matching the ~4.4% camouflage the v1.1 correction note describes

constants.corroboration: Two INDEPENDENT from-definition reimplementations (recompute_basis.py and S_prefactor_verify.py) agree on the 2*pi-convention value to 20 digits. The 2*pi convention is the theoretically-correct large-order/resurgence normalization.
status_notes: VALUE is computationally trustworthy: confirmed to 46 stable digits by two independent recomputes under the explicit, identified 2*pi convention.

PUBLISHED PROVENANCE IS UNRESOLVED. The v1.1 correction (2*pi prefactor, 0.45790662..., 38-digit claim) is described in the paper ABSTRACT but was NOT located in the searched deposit artifacts. The deposited manuscript PDF found in-repo (submitted-manuscripts/painlev-iiid6-resurgence-constant-quadratic-polynomial/manuscript.pdf) is the v1.0/Gamma version: it states S ~ 0.43770528 to EIGHT digits and labels it 'unidentified'. No deposited source for >8 digits of the 2*pi value was found.
The high-precision tail (digits beyond ~8) rests ONLY on the two mutually-agreeing recomputes, NOT on any located published artifact.

REPO SCRIPTS ARE STALE: pcf-research/vquad/scripts/{t2_iter20,t2_iter22,t2_iter23,t2_iter24,jimbo_final} hardcode the retracted Gamma-prefactor value 0.43770528. They reproduce the v1.0 error and need the 2*pi fix or a KNOWN_ISSUE note.
